subject: Launch next week — temporary burst & proforma timing
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlinecommerce.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Beth Lopez <beth.lopez@brightlinecommerce.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch next week — temporary burst and invoice timing

Hi Jonas,

We have a major feature launch scheduled for next Tuesday and expect a big spike in inference volume for the first 48–72 hours. Early estimates attached (Brightline_Usage_Estimate_May2028.csv) — peak sustained QPS ~ 2800 for ~6 hours, then tapering.

Two asks: can Redwood provide a short-term burst uplift (headroom) for the launch window, and can you send a proforma invoice up front so our Finance team can approve payment timing? Ideally we want the proforma to reflect the estimated burst overrun and then do a true-up against actuals post-launch.

Also: our procurement prefers Net-45 for external invoices. If there are any options for a first-launch discount on overrun fees, that would help justify the spend to our CFO.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Brightline Commerce

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlinecommerce.com>
Cc: Beth Lopez <beth.lopez@brightlinecommerce.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch next week — temporary burst and invoice timing

Samir — thanks for the heads up and for sending the estimate. We can put a temporary burst bridge in place for the launch window and issue a proforma for the estimated overrun amount. I attached a draft addendum for the burst uplift (proposed-burst-addendum-v0.1.pdf) showing how the temporary capacity will be billed and how we handle the post-launch true-up.

Quick clarification items so we can finalize:
- Confirm exact UTC start/end for the uplift window you want Redwood to enable (so we can pin capacity scheduling).
- Confirm whether the Net-45 request applies to both the proforma and the true-up invoice or only the final settled invoice.
- Any appetite for a short-term promotional concession on the overrun fees (e.g., a % discount for the first 14 days) in exchange for a commitment to a reserved pool starting July.

Looping in Ben (pricing) and Marissa (billing) to confirm feasibility and timing. I can issue the proforma once we lock the window and pricing.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Beth Lopez <beth.lopez@brightlinecommerce.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlinecommerce.com>
Date: Thu, 31 May 2028 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch next week — temporary burst and invoice timing

Jonas — thanks. Confirming the launch window will be: 2028-06-06T02:00:00Z through 2028-06-07T08:00:00Z (UTC). Peak load ~2800 QPS for roughly 6 hours within that window.

To Samir's point, procurement prefers to see a proforma now (so it can be routed through our approvals). Net-45 is their preference for the final invoice, but they will accept Net-30 for the proforma if needed. We'd like to request a short promotional concession on the burst overage for the first 14 days post-launch — even a modest 15–25% would materially help us. In return we're willing to sign a 6-month reserved capacity commitment starting 2028-07-01 (size TBD) if we can get that introductory uplift discount.

Let me know what you can do and I can take it back to Finance.

—Beth
Beth Lopez
Director, Launch Operations — Brightline Commerce

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Beth Lopez <beth.lopez@brightlinecommerce.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlinecommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Jun 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch next week — temporary burst and invoice timing

Beth / Samir — appreciate the context. We can support a short-term promotional discount on overage charges for the initial launch period conditional on a downstream reserved commitment. Proposed commercial terms:

- Temporary burst uplift: Enable additional headroom for 2028-06-06T02:00:00Z through 2028-06-07T08:00:00Z as requested.
- Discount: 20% off overage rates for burst usage incurred during the first 14 days following the uplift window (applies to tokens billed as "burst overrun").
- Commitment: Brightline agrees to a 6-month reserved pool starting 2028-07-01. We can size the reserved pool after launch based on actuals; the 20% discount is conditional on signing the commitment within 14 days after the launch true-up.
- Billing / True-up: We will issue a proforma for the estimated burst amount before the launch. Actuals will be reconciled and any true-up (credit or additional charge) will be reflected on the next monthly invoice.

Marissa — are we able to allow Net-45 on the final invoice while issuing the proforma as Net-30? That aligns with their procurement note. Also, please confirm the DocuSign path (addendum + SOW) so Jonas can send to Brightline.

If that works, Jonas: I recommend we send the proforma this afternoon and mark the addendum "temporary-burst-addendum — pending signature".

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Beth Lopez <beth.lopez@brightlinecommerce.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlinecommerce.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Jun 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch next week — temporary burst and invoice timing

Thanks all — confirm we can proceed as Ben outlined. Billing steps:

1) Proforma: Redwood will generate a proforma invoice reflecting the estimated burst overrun (attached: burst-proforma-Brightline-Jun2028.pdf). This will be issued immediately and can be configured as Net-30 to satisfy procurement for the approval flow.
2) Launch & Usage: We enable the uplift during the requested UTC window and capture actual usage.
3) True-up: Actual overrun will be reconciled and any variance will be applied as a true-up on Brightline's next monthly invoice. Final invoice can be set to Net-45 per your procurement preference.
4) Addendum & Signature: We'll send a DocuSign envelope with the temporary-burst-addendum (links in Drive). Signing the addendum confirms the uplift scheduling and the conditional 20% discount if the 6-month reserved commitment is signed within 14 days post-launch.

Next steps for Jonas / Brightline:
- Jonas: send the proforma and DocuSign addendum to Beth & Samir.
- Brightline: review and confirm the commitment timeline so we can lock the conditional discount.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Brightline_Usage_Estimate_May2028.csv (Samir), proposed-burst-addendum-v0.1.pdf (Jonas), burst-proforma-Brightline-Jun2028.pdf (Marissa).
